stories.title: Thursday briefing: Why young people are having less sex than ever
stories.summary: In today’s newsletter: A new study of sexual trends in Britain has found that one in three under-25s have never had sex, a flashy headline that obscures the real reasons behind a ‘sex recession’ among young people Good morning. Let’s talk about sex! I know, I know; it’s not 9am yet. But trust me, you’ll enjoy it and I won’t ask you to do anything that puts your back out before your first brew. The National Survey of Sexual Attitudes and Lifestyles, or Natsal, is a big-deal publication: a substantial piece of research capturing trends in British intimacy every decade since 1990. This week, it made more headlines than usual with the revelation that sex among adults of all genders and sexualities has slumped – and the standout finding that one in three under-25s report they have never had sexual intercourse.
